title: Tone Practice 2
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Science Note

"The pattern is intriguing, although the dataset is too small to support a strong conclusion."

TEXT B - Thank-You Note

"You noticed every problem before it became everyone else's problem."

TEXT C - Opinion Column

"The city does not need another promise printed on a banner. It needs a repair schedule."

TEXT D - Travel Essay

"The station is not beautiful in the usual sense, but at dawn its worn tiles seem to remember every departure."

questions.explanation: Intriguing shows interest; the warning about the dataset shows caution.
questions.rule: Use the exact wording and surrounding context as evidence.

options.whyWrong: “confident and conclusive” makes the text more certain or extreme than its wording supports.
“doubtful and dismissive” misses the effect created by the author’s wording or perspective.
“excited and celebratory” is more emotionally extreme than the wording supports.
